gate_features (from SIP 1-minute bars, p.A_blocks: fast %R (21, EWM 7) at t minus fast %R at t-10 < 15
gate_features (from SIP 1-minute bars, p.B_blocks: either (1) slow %R (112, EWM 3) at t minus at t-5 < 0, or (2) the last COMPLETED 5-minute bar's slow %R (28, EWM 3) minus the previous 5-minute bar's < 0 (ai_watch_wr_slow_5m_min_pitch is 0). per_gate_decision.statistic: lift = mean net of signals the gate PASSES minus mean net of signals it BLOCKS; day-clustered t (two-sample, day-clustered SEs)
per_gate_decision.KEEP: lift >= +2.0 bp with t >= 2.0 on DECIDE and lift > 0 on CONFIRM - the gate avoids worse buys
per_gate_decision.REMOVE: lift <= +0.5 bp on DECIDE and <= +0.5 on CONFIRM - the blocked buys are no worse, so the gate only costs opens
per_gate_decision.UNCLEAR: anything else - leave the gate as it is
per_gate_decision.enough: >= 200 traded signals on each side of the gate on DECIDE, else UNDERPOWERED (leave as is)

information_only: both gates together (pass both vs blocked by either); opens per 10 minutes each gate removes; the gate's block rate; 10-minute gross; time of day
if_REMOVE: turn that gate off after the close under the operator's 11/18 rule (config only, hot-reloads)
